description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), causes [Imperil Lightning 20%] for 25 seconds, grants [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Chant] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Chant
description.text: Summoning and Bard abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Summoning and Bard abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Thunder Encore after using two Summoning or Bard abilities
